title: Signature Graphics / travel and welcome
slide_intent: Use recognizable landmarks to connect a message with a destination before detailed reading.
strategic_value: DB’s line-built landmarks can support route and welcome messages in a common visual language.
demonstration: A HAM-to-BER graphic pairs two colored landmarks; a framed Frankfurt welcome poster uses a pale skyline with a red focal building.
practical_value: Compare paired destination symbols with a wider city panorama.

content_islands.name: Route pair
content_islands.spec: Place two landmark graphics above the abbreviated city labels and directional arrow.

content_islands.name: Welcome poster
content_islands.spec: Place the headline above a pale skyline with one red focus.

reference_purposes.Application: The two compositions apply signature graphics to a route message and city welcome poster.
